## Español

Correcciones a partir de los informes (ZIP) adjuntos en los issues:

- **Crash at the cutscenes after the first races** (Kenji's intro, the Bushido / first rival cutscene): a jump in the game code that the recompilation had left unresolved. It now plays through.

releases.name: NFS Carbon Android v0.3.2 - drivers Vulkan y compatibilidad
releases.body:
# NFS Carbon Android v0.3.2

Carbon incorpora las mejoras de compatibilidad de Most Wanted 0.5.4, el selector de drivers Vulkan y las actualizaciones opcionales, conservando su launcher, idiomas y controles.

## Mejoras

- Adaptación del renderer y de los shaders para GPU que admiten solo **cuatro conjuntos de descriptores**, presentes en algunos Mali y otros dispositivos.
- Conversión **BC4/BC5 en CPU con Xclipse** y el driver propietario de Samsung.
- **Sincronización ARM adaptada a las funciones de Carbon**: se publican las órdenes completas antes de ejecutarlas desde otro hilo, corrigiendo una causa de posibles cierres al entrar a carrera.
- **Drivers Vulkan externos:** importa, selecciona, prueba y elimina ZIPs Android ARM64. La prueba se ejecuta en un proceso independiente y muestra GPU, Vulkan y funciones disponibles. Puedes volver al driver del sistema.
- **Avisos opcionales de nuevas versiones** de este repositorio con **Actualizar** o **Más tarde**, más **Buscar actualizaciones** en el launcher. Puedes seguir jugando sin actualizar ni tener conexión; no se instalan ni descargan APKs automáticamente.

Se instala encima de la v0.3.0. Necesitas la edición **Xbox 360** de Carbon con el `default.xex` indicado en el README.

Fixes on top of v0.3.0:

releases.name: xbased 1.1.11
releases.body:
## 1.1.11 (2026-11)

### Interface
- Every option has a short description under the list, in all 11
  languages. In the in-game menu it also says when a change takes effect:
  right away, when you go back to the game, or the next time it starts.

  as plain text under the list, without the dark box.
- A game's settings are in sections (video, audio, system) and have their

releases.name: 0.4.0 Faster Sync
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版主要提速：比较只看文件大小和修改日期，不再逐个计算哈希；内容边打包边发送、边收边解包，接收端的备份与传输同时进行。Android 授予“所有文件访问权限”后直接读写存档目录，扫描、备份和写入都快很多。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.1，设备、游戏和备份设置都会保留。备份设置格式已升级，旧版应用读不了，不支持降级。
- **两端必须一起升级**：比较和传输协议与 0.3.x 不兼容，一端是旧版时会在开始传输前提示更新两端。
- **Android 最低版本提高到 Android 11。**

## 新功能

- **按大小和修改日期比较**：两端文件大小相同、修改日期相差不超过 2 秒即视为相同，扫描只列目录，不再读取文件内容计算 SHA-256。写入后目标文件的修改日期设为来源的修改日期，下次比较显示相同。
- **流式传输**：发送端直接把文件打包进网络流，接收端边收边解包，本机不再生成快照或压缩包。数据不完整或中途断开时目标不变。
- **备份与传输并行**：接收端登记任务后马上开始备份，同时接收内容，备份完成且内容收齐后再写入。进度分为备份、传输、写入三段。
- **备份阶段显示百分比**：两端界面和 Android 通知在备份时都显示进度，不再一直转圈。
- **Android 所有文件访问权限**：授权后游戏目录直接按路径读写，不经 SAF。设置页显示授权状态并可跳到系统授权页，首次添加游戏后会提示一次；未授权时照常经 SAF 读写。

## 修复与改进

- 备份和写入去掉多余的重读、逐文件 fsync 和反复列目录，Android 扫描、备份和打包时同时打开多个文件。约 500 个文件、100 MiB 的存档目录，两端备份从约 5 分钟降到数秒。
- 备份按游戏归组：重新选择游戏目录后，旧目录的备份照常列出、参与轮换，也能恢复到当前目录。
- “重新扫描”沿用上次传输的方向，不再回到默认的电脑传移动端。
- 一端取消传输时两端都记为已取消，另一端不再显示“传输失败：网络连接中断”。
- 手机上传途中断网时两端都按网络中断结束，不再报“请求内容无效”或被电脑记为用户取消。
- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。
- 手机发送途中断网或应用被结束时，电脑不再卡住到 30 分钟期限才能开始新的比较和传输。
- 对方存档目录改名后又改回，刷新即可重新比较，不用断开重连。

releases.name: 0.3.1 Seamless Connection
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版完成“连接与重连”：Android 不用再手动输入 IP，可以从附近设备列表或扫码连接电脑；电脑换了地址后，Android 点“连接”会自动找到新地址重连。

## 新功能

- **局域网发现**：电脑端服务运行时在局域网广播本机，Android 设备页的“附近”列表会列出同一网络中的电脑，点一下即可连接。
- **扫码连接**：电脑端设备页显示连接二维码，Android 扫码即可连接。二维码带多个候选地址，推荐地址不可用时会依次尝试其他地址；深色主题下二维码随主题变色。
- **设备页重新设计（两端）**：电脑端显示服务卡片、二维码和推荐地址，推荐地址优先取物理网卡上有默认网关的地址；已保存的设备按最近连接排序，在附近的设备会标出来。
- **换地址后自动重连**：电脑因 DHCP 或换网络改了 IP、端口时，Android 点已保存设备的“连接”，会在连接原地址的同时在后台按设备 ID 查找这台电脑；原地址连不上就自动连接新地址并更新保存的地址，游戏和目录设置都保留。
- **界面用语**：两端改用“本机”“对方设备”或设备名称来称呼双方，不再按“电脑”“移动端”区分。

## 修复与改进

- 修正 Windows Portable 包缺少模块、无法启动的问题。
- 电脑端只显示按默认网关和路由优先级推荐的 IPv4 地址，不再列出虚拟网卡等无关地址。
- 对方设备异常断开（如电脑端停止服务）后立即点“连接”，不再提示“正在执行其他任务”。
- 设备页加载图标与文字对齐，标“在附近”的行与其他行等高。
- 开屏动画立绘更新，适配平板等大屏设备。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.0，存档、设备和游戏设置都会保留。
- 两端请一起升级：0.3.0 的电脑端不会广播，Android 的“附近”列表搜不到它，二维码也需要新版电脑端显示。

## 已知限制

- 发现依赖局域网组播（mDNS，UDP 5353）。路由器开启 AP 隔离、访客网络或屏蔽组播时搜不到设备，需用扫码或手动输入地址连接。
- Windows 首次运行时可能弹出防火墙提示，需要允许专用网络访问，否则 Android 无法连接电脑。
- 对方地址没有回应时（例如防火墙丢弃请求），连接约 5 秒后才提示失败。
- 扫码需要授予 Android 相机权限。
- Windows Portable 版和 APK 未经商店分发，首次运行时系统可能提示来源未知。

* * *

> [!NOTE]

releases.name: 0.3.0 Experience Enhancement
releases.body:
## 升级须知

> [!CAUTION]
> **Android 务必先卸载旧版再安装。** 0.3.0 的备份位置和格式都变了，不再读取旧备份。
> 直接升级将导致旧备份永远保留在设备上。
> 卸载会清除应用数据和旧备份，需要重新添加游戏、关联设备并授权目录。

- **旧备份不能带到 0.3.0。** 如果还要用旧备份里的存档，请在升级前先恢复。
- 电脑端的旧备份不再显示，也不会自动清理，可以点备份页的“打开文件夹”手动删除。电脑端的备份开关和保留份数会恢复默认。
- 电脑端和移动端需要一起升级。
- Windows 只提供免安装版，未做代码签名，首次运行时可能出现 SmartScreen 提示。

## 新功能

- **传输时可以删除目标多出的文件。** 目标有来源没有的文件时，传输页会出现“保留/删除”开关。
- **备份可以直接管理。** 两端的备份都改成文件夹，按 `游戏名/UTC 时间` 存放。移动端放在 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/`，可以用能访问该目录的文件管理器查看和删除；电脑端可以从备份页打开文件夹。
- **备份页可以删除单份备份。** 备份页还会显示实际文件数和不完整备份的占用，并可以清理不完整的备份。
- **适配平板。** 屏幕最短边不小于 600dp 的设备支持横竖屏，主导航移到左上角，内容限制最大宽度，游戏列表按宽度增加列数。手机固定竖屏。
- **两端互看传输进度和结果。** 无论从哪一端发起，两端都能看到进度和逐项结果，也可以取消传输。每个游戏都能查看最近的传输。
- **写入中断提示。** 写入途中应用被关闭时，下次打开会提示文件可能不完整；有备份时可以直接跳到备份。
- **目录失效提示。** 目录被改名或授权失效时，游戏设置页的目录行会显示警告并提供“重新选择”。
- **开屏动画从后台返回时也会播放。** 回到桌面或切换应用后再打开都会播放。为了不闪过离开前的页面，Android 13 及以上的最近任务不再显示页面缩略图。

## 改进

- **移除游戏时会一并删除这个游戏的备份。**
- 启动时进入设备页；从后台返回时留在原页。
- 两端统一返回规则：返回到进入当前页之前的页面；传输详情返回游戏页。Android 返回键逐级返回，最后退出。
- 两端分别统一动效。移动端切页改成两页一起整屏平移，按钮和列表项使用相同的按下反馈；电脑端的列表项和卡片使用相同的悬停和按下效果。
- 移动端页面铺满系统栏，状态栏和页面背景连成一片，弹层遮罩也能盖住状态栏。
- 错误提示尽量写明出错的是电脑还是移动端。
- 比较结果过期后不再报错，会显示黄色提示并自动重新比较，确认后才开始传输。

releases.name: 0.2.0 UI Refactor
releases.body:
## 升级须知

- **Android 需要先卸载旧版再安装。** 0.2.0 起安装包改用固定发布密钥，无法覆盖安装 0.1.0、0.1.1。卸载会清除应用数据，需要重新添加游戏、关联设备并授权目录。
- 电脑端和手机端需要一起升级。
- Windows 只提供免安装版，未做代码签名，首次运行时可能出现 SmartScreen 提示。

## 新功能

- **双端界面重做。** 设备、游戏、任务、传输、备份和设置页换成同一套布局与视觉。各页面分离主次信息。
- **加入 i18n 支持。** 简中、繁中、英语、日语，默认跟随系统，也可以固定一种；Android 的通知会使用所选语言。
- **手动切换主题。** 跟随系统、浅色、深色，保存在本机。
- **备份份数可调。** 默认保留 3 份，可在 1 到 10 之间调整；每个游戏可以跟随全局，也可以单独设置。
- **Android 开屏动画。** 希望各位喜欢~

## 改进

- 手机传输页重新设计，高亮展示两端文件差异，按新增、减少、覆盖、保留等着色。
- 同步计划页顶部汇总文件操作数量，下方明细分组列出文件。
- 传输详情改成进度环加五步进度条，以及详细信息。
- 游戏设置页关联设备显示更直观了。
- 设置页重新设计 UI，更耐看了。
- 备份页显示当前策略和每次备份的时间线。

## 修复

- 修复自动备份存档时，只备份当次传输所变更的文件的问题。
- 修复清除系统浏览器数据可能造成应用数据丢失的问题（手机端的配置改到 Android 原生存储）。
- 修正文字选择、设备地址显示和启动失败时的提示。
- 修复路径显示分行的分割点。
- 修复不能覆盖安装更新 App 的问题（发布工作流使用固定密钥构建 APK）。

---

## Upgrade Notes

- **On Android, you must uninstall the old version before installing.** Starting with 0.2.0, the installer uses a fixed release key, so it cannot be installed over 0.1.0 or 0.1.1. Uninstalling will clear app data, so you will need to re-add games, link devices, and authorize directories.
- Desktop and mobile must be upgraded together.

releases.name: 0.1.1 E2E Expansion
releases.body:
## 升级须知

- 由于传输方式更改，电脑端和手机端要一起升级到 0.1.1。
- Android 可以直接覆盖安装 0.1.0，游戏、目录授权和备份都会保留。

## 新功能

- **在电脑上发起传输。** 在电脑的“传输存档”里选好方向，点“扫描并预览”，手机会扫描两端目录，把计划发回电脑。你在电脑上确认后，手机开始传输，完成后电脑显示“传输完成。”。手机 → 电脑、电脑 → 手机都可以。手机需要开着应用并连上电脑。

## 改进

- 两端改用 Websocket 连接。电脑浏览手机目录、发起传输都不用再等，手机目录打开就显示，不用手动刷新。
- 在电脑上修改游戏配置后，手机会马上同步更新。
- 手机关闭应用或断开连接时，电脑会立即提示。如果这时传输已经开始，会提示到任务列表查看结果。

## 修复

- 手机传输详情里，同一个文件的结果会重复出现，切换到其他页面后还会残留。

## 开发

- 桌面开发模式的页面服务改为监听 127.0.0.1 上的随机空闲端口。
- 在不搜索当前目录可执行文件的 shell 中（设置了 `NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath`），`pnpm android:build` 也能找到 Gradle Wrapper 了。

---

## Upgrade Notes

- The computer and phone must both be upgraded to 0.1.1. The connection method between the two ends has changed; 0.1.0 and 0.1.1 cannot connect to each other.
- On Android, you can install 0.1.1 directly over 0.1.0. Games, directory authorizations, and backups will be preserved.

## New Features

> [!NOTE]
> 这一版主要提速：比较只看文件大小和修改日期，不再逐个计算哈希；内容边打包边发送、边收边解包，接收端的备份与传输同时进行。Android 授予“所有文件访问权限”后直接读写存档目录，扫描、备份和写入都快很多。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.1，设备、游戏和备份设置都会保留。备份设置格式已升级，旧版应用读不了，不支持降级。

- **Android 最低版本提高到 Android 11。**

## 新功能

- **按大小和修改日期比较**：两端文件大小相同、修改日期相差不超过 2 秒即视为相同，扫描只列目录，不再读取文件内容计算 SHA-256。写入后目标文件的修改日期设为来源的修改日期，下次比较显示相同。
- **流式传输**：发送端直接把文件打包进网络流，接收端边收边解包，本机不再生成快照或压缩包。数据不完整或中途断开时目标不变。
- **备份与传输并行**：接收端登记任务后马上开始备份，同时接收内容，备份完成且内容收齐后再写入。进度分为备份、传输、写入三段。
- **备份阶段显示百分比**：两端界面和 Android 通知在备份时都显示进度，不再一直转圈。
- **Android 所有文件访问权限**：授权后游戏目录直接按路径读写，不经 SAF。设置页显示授权状态并可跳到系统授权页，首次添加游戏后会提示一次；未授权时照常经 SAF 读写。

- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。

releases.name: v0.4.7
releases.body:
Phones get new defaults that run smoother and cooler, voices on Android should come through again, and every platform gets a Render scale option. Everything from [0.4.6](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.6) is included.

## Android

- **Frame rate unlocked with a 45 fps limit, by default.** Uncapped, the phone's GPU runs at full load until the phone lowers its clock as it heats up; the limit keeps headroom. The limit drops to the nearest rate that divides your screen's refresh, so every frame lasts the same: 40 fps on a 120 Hz screen (Galaxy S24/S25), 45 at 90 Hz, 30 at 60 Hz. On an S25 Ultra frame times went from a 25/25/16.7 ms mix to an even 25 ms. You can still pick 30, 60 or no limit in Device Options > Display > Frame rate limit.
- **Render scale 75 % by default.** The 3D scene is drawn at 75 % and scaled up to the screen; on an S25 Ultra that is 14 % less GPU work per frame, with a slightly softer picture. Graphics > Render scale goes back to 100 %.
- **Snapdragon GSR for the final upscale by default**, one pass instead of FSR 1's two.

releases.name: v0.4.6
releases.body:
Insane can now be picked from the start. Everything from [0.4.5](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.5) is included; if you have not read its notes, they cover the Riftworm fix for Vulkan, GPU detection on Linux and Proton, and the co-op go-to-player-1 key.

## Every platform

- **Insane without finishing the campaign first.** The option from 0.4.5, now named **All chapters and Insane unlocked** (PC Options > Saves, on by default), also enables the Insane button in the difficulty menu, in solo Campaign and in the co-op lobby. Before, the game greyed it out until the campaign had been finished once. As with chapters, only the menu check changes: your saved progress and the Extras list of unlockables are not touched.

## Known, still open

- Lighting that looks pixelated on Linux with presets above Low, and black textures on Low on Windows (both on a Legion Go): we could not reproduce them on our PC. A screenshot and the `logs/gow2_*.log` of the run, with the chapter, help a lot.

releases.name: v0.4.5
releases.body:
The Riftworm interior no longer crashes or goes black with Vulkan, the game picks the right GPU settings on Linux and under Proton, every chapter can be picked from the start, and co-op gets a key and a controller combo to go to player 1. Everything from [0.4.4](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.4) is included.

## Vulkan (Linux and SteamOS, Proton with Vulkan, Android, Vulkan on Windows)

- **Inside the Riftworm (act 5) no longer loses the GPU.** The worm's flesh is drawn with tessellation, and the shaders the renderer builds for it read their settings from the wrong slot, so the tessellation factor came from unrelated memory: the scene stayed black, would not load, or the game closed with a lost device. Fixed in SDK patch 0091 (found with the Khronos validation layer). On a Radeon RX 7800 XT the worm interior now runs 120 s at 60 fps where it failed within seconds. Under Proton, Vulkan (`gpu_backend = vulkan`) is the backend to use for that chapter: D3D12 through vkd3d-proton was also reported to lose the device there and we could not test it.

## Linux and SteamOS

releases.name: v0.4.4
releases.body:
Less memory traffic on phone GPUs, less work per draw on the GPU command thread, and a new option for the CPU core the game spins while it waits for the GPU. Everything from [0.4.3](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.3) is included.

## Vulkan (Android, Linux and SteamOS, Vulkan on Windows)

- **Each render pass now covers only what it draws.** The renderer sizes its render targets for the console's whole EDRAM (1520x3456 on the phone) and every render pass loaded and stored all of it, even when its draws touched only the 1280x720 of a 720p frame. Phone GPUs render in tiles and pay for every byte a pass loads and stores, so they moved about 5.7 times the memory they needed. Now each pass begins with only the area its draws and clears can write (SDK patch 0089). It follows the Vulkan rules, so the picture should not change; it has not been measured on a phone yet. If part of the picture looks missing or stale, set `vulkan_tight_render_area = false` in `gow2.toml` (it takes effect at once) and open an issue with the scene. Direct3D 12, the Windows default, is not affected.

## Every platform

releases.name: v0.4.3
releases.body:
A new Android APK that survives leaving the game, a leaner game binary on every platform, and threads that sleep instead of polling on Linux and Android. Everything from [0.4.2](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.2) is included.

## Android

- **Leaving the game and coming back no longer crashes it.** Home, switching to another app or the screen turning off, then coming back: up to 0.3.18 the return crashed (in `vkCreateAndroidSurfaceKHR`, with a window Android had already freed). Now the game lets go of the old window when it leaves the screen and connects to the new one when it comes back (SDK patch 0085). The game keeps running while it is off screen (only the picture and the sound stop), so pause it before you leave.
- **The update dialog holds the game until you answer it**, instead of letting it start behind the dialog, and the phone only offers releases that carry an APK (0.4.2 was for PC and Linux only).

# NSP Box 4.0.0 — Meet NUP

Smaller archives, flexible packaging, and more control over your game collection. Version 4.0 introduces **NUP Tools**, alongside the existing NSP builder.

### Package more. Store less.

- **Create compressed NUP archives** from extracted game folders, with base games, updates and DLC together in one file.
- **Choose your balance:** Fast for quicker compression, Balanced for everyday use, or Smaller for stronger compression. Incompressible files are stored raw automatically.
- **Keep what you need:** select Base, Updates and DLC independently. Choices appear after inspection, only for content present in your source. Latest-snapshot mode merges the newest selected update with the selected base, retains required base-only files, and leaves superseded versions behind. Turn it off to keep separate base/update records.
- **Avoid duplicate storage:** identical file contents can share the same space inside an archive.
- **Stay compatible:** leave files larger than 256 MiB uncompressed to reduce temporary decompression work in supported emulators.

### Convert, extract and check

- **NSP → NUP:** compress plaintext NSPs created by NSP Box.

releases.name: Version 5.10.0
releases.body:
Changes:

- refs: Image names are now checked using Docker's rules. Malformed names are refused with a clear message.
- install: Added support for images pinned by digest, e.g. `ubuntu@sha256:...`. The download is verified against the digest. A pinned image can be reinstalled from the cache without network.
- build, push: A digest is refused in `build -t` and `push`.
- install: Fixed intact image layers sometimes refused with "does not match its digest".
- http: Redirects can no longer move a download from HTTPS to plain HTTP. `--allow-insecure` lifts this.
- registry: `--allow-insecure` no longer applies to Docker Hub. It is always verified.
- http: Network requests give up after 2 minutes of silence instead of hanging forever.
- http: Invalid URLs and registry addresses now show an error message instead of a traceback.
- build, login: Bytes that are not valid UTF-8 in arguments, build args or image environment no longer cause a traceback.
- list, remove: `--image` no longer prints control characters from cache entries as they are.
- sync, copy: Files that change during the transfer are handled correctly. No more missed updates or wrong permissions.

releases.name: WatermelonDS 0.8.0.rc2: Vulkan, Audio and Library Stability Update!
releases.body:
# WatermelonDS 0.8.0.rc2 is here!!!

This release focuses on smoother high-resolution Vulkan performance, audio and graphics fixes reported by the community, and quality-of-life improvements for libraries, saves, and RetroAchievements. --- ## Vulkan performance improvements Vulkan has received major performance and stability improvements in this release. Repeated calculations and redundant reads were reduced, and rendering work is now grouped more efficiently. These improvements benefit different internal resolutions and are not exclusive to a single chipset or device family. Tested results include: | Device / SoC | Internal Resolution | Result in tested sections | |---|---:|---| | T820 | **6x** | Close to **60 FPS** in the tested sections of Spirit Tracks, Phantom Hourglass, and Dragon Ball Origins. releases.name: WatermelonDS 0.7.0 is finally here!
releases.body: ## This is a very special release. After several release candidates under the **melonDualDS** name, the project is now officially renamed to: # WatermelonDS This is the final **0.7.0** release and the first public release with the new WatermelonDS identity. releases.name: melonDualDS 0.7.0 RC5: RetroAchievements Stability Update!
releases.body:
# Next release will be WatermelonDS!

This release is focused on RetroAchievements stability, Hardcore achievement reliability, leaderboards, and new offline achievement provider options.

This will also be the last release using the current **melonDualDS** name.

The next release will introduce a new interface, a new icon, and a new experimental Vulkan feature called **FastPath**. FastPath is designed to significantly improve performance at high internal resolutions, even up to 8x in some cases.

However, FastPath will be experimental. If you want the most stable and accurate experience, closer to real Nintendo DS behavior, it is recommended to keep FastPath disabled when it becomes available. It will be especially useful for devices with slightly weaker chipsets, or for users who want to get the most performance and battery efficiency possible.

For RC5, the focus is not Vulkan, UI changes, or general emulator fixes. This release is mainly about making RetroAchievements more stable, more reliable, and more flexible.

Preview 1 could close immediately without showing the launcher. Its rebuilt APK omitted 146 original artwork files required during application startup. Preview 2 restores those files, preserves their authentication and touch icons, and adds checks using the final signed APK's own resources.

Install **XHYN-V-0.3-Preview2.apk** over Preview 1; the app ID and release key are unchanged, and the version code is newer. There is no need to uninstall first. **XHYN V Bridge stays at 0.1.0**; an already installed copy does not need updating.

releases.name: v2.5.17 — Microsoft sign-in
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Microsoft sign-in no longer opens a blank white page** ([#3](https://github.com/FlameLaunchers/FlameLauncher-Android/issues/3)). Android's WebView puts `; wv` in its user agent, Microsoft reads that as an embedded browser and refuses the page — and what you get is not a message, it is an empty white screen. The marker is gone from the user agent now.

  Two more things the sign-in page needs were missing: cross-site cookies, which `login.live.com` relies on, and a `WebChromeClient`, without which the popups and dialogs the flow opens are silently dropped. The iOS build never hit any of this because WKWebView reports itself as Safari and handles those by default.
- **A sign-in page that fails to load now says why.** Main-frame errors were going nowhere, so a failure left the same white screen with nothing to report.

releases.name: v2.5.16 — Minecraft 26.4 snapshots
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Minecraft 26.4 snapshots start.** A version id like `26.4-snapshot-3` splits into `26` and `4-snapshot-3`, and reading that second part as a plain integer gave nothing — so 26.4 was treated as 26.0, missed the SDL and LWJGL 3.4.3 stack, and launched on LWJGL 3.3.6 instead. The game died immediately with `NoClassDefFoundError: org/lwjgl/sdl/SDLPlatform`; the cacio lines in the crash report were a consequence, not the cause. Version numbers are now read digit by digit, so snapshot, pre-release and rc suffixes no longer hide them, and five tests cover the shapes.
- Carries the previous fix as well: on Java 24 and newer the cacio java agent is skipped, because the `sun.misc.Unsafe` calls its `premain` depends on are refused there and a failing agent takes the VM with it.

releases.name: v2.5.15 — Minecraft 26.4 starts again
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Minecraft 26.4 (and anything else on Java 24 or newer) starts again.** The cacio setup loaded a java agent whose `premain` overwrites the AWT toolkit's static fields through `sun.misc.Unsafe` (`staticFieldBase`, `staticFieldOffset`, `putObject`). Those methods are refused from JDK 24 and gone in 26, and a failing agent takes the whole VM down with it — which surfaced as a cacio error at startup.

  The iOS build has always run the same cacio jars without that agent, on the same Java 25, using only `-Dawt.toolkit` and `-Xbootclasspath/a`. Android now does the same on Java 24+ and keeps the agent only for the older runtimes that still need it.

releases.name: Spektralab-X 0.2.00-alpha-6
releases.body:
**省流：** 不选胶卷也能只用滤镜保存图片，自定义组合保存得更完整；RAW 少占一些内存，测光和曲线少做重复计算。界面保持原样，未大规模真机验证，需要社区反馈。

内部安装版本码递增为 **126**，沿用原发布签名，可覆盖安装。本轮共创：**GPT（OpenAI，AI 助手）**。

### 滤镜和胶卷自由搭配

- 胶卷选“无”后，数字调色和 LUT 继续生效，可通过原有保存入口导出图片。胶卷、相纸和数字调整按用户现有选择组合，不增加模式或范围控件。
- “存为风格”和“分享当前风格”记录当前完整选择，包括明确的无胶卷状态、物理细调、效果开关及记住的强度；重新套用时不再漏掉这些设置。局部蒙版留在当前照片，RAW 白平衡、裁切和边框不进入可复用风格。
- 新版 `.spklook` 写出 version 2，并继续读取旧 version 1 文件。旧应用不能保证还原 v2 的全部新语义；自定义配方基于已有胶卷、相纸及参数，每张图仍使用一个物理方案和一个数字调色层 / LUT。

### RAW 少复制，计算少重复

- 对满足条件的整数 RAW，将解码结果直接转换到工作尺寸，避免先创建完整的浮点中间图；最终 Bitmap 分配前释放已用完的原始存储。
- 对严格兼容的整数 LinearRaw 子集，一次性处理直接接管已有像素存储，减少一份整图复制。浮点精度路径、黑白点及方向处理保留原有约定，并检查取消和失败时的存储状态。
- 同一次显示计算只准备一次曲线；自动测光和场景亮度统计复用已完成的精确分区，减少重复选择工作。逐项对照保留原有数值结果，没有更换胶片光谱、默认显影或成像公式。
- 吸收上游 Sony Huffman 解码缓存索引保护，保留合法索引的既有计算；尚未用真实问题 Sony 原片完成复现验收。

### 验证范围

本轮分项云端验证包含 172 项 Release JVM 测试、3 项原有界面风格保存 / 导入测试、完整 LibRaw 的 ASan / UBSan 检查、ARM64 JNI 编译，以及测光和场景统计的 1460 项数值对照；真实 Vulkan 胶片与印放对照输出保持一致。发布仍须通过整包构建、原生回归、签名证书及 16 KiB 对齐检查。

**未大规模真机验证，需要社区反馈。** 云端的耗时及内存改善不等于手机整张导出同比提速，也不保证所有 RAW 都降低峰值。新 RAW 仍默认线性显示，递归模糊、交互色表及完整外存分块实验继续默认关闭。

这次集中处理社区 [#17](https://github.com/Dear-Ded/Spektralab-X/issues/17) 反馈的窄条画面、黑块和紫色色块。暗房里算坏的底片，不能盖个“保存成功”就交卷。

内部安装版本码递增为 **125**，沿用原发布签名，可覆盖安装。本轮共创：**GPT（OpenAI，AI 助手）**。

### 修复异常像素被放行

- 修复浮点 RGB 中的 NaN、正负无穷在转成整数时丢失错误信息的问题。这些值原来会变成黑色或偏色像素，alpha 和文件结构却仍然正常；只要局部还有画面，旧的纯色检查就可能放行。
- 现在在整数转换和结果缓存前扫描全部 RGB 通道，记录首个异常像素的位置和通道；同时检查扫描工作组是否完整执行。异常结果停止交付，不进入后续保存。
- 导出前还会核对 RGBA16 布局及每个有效像素的 alpha，拦截未完整写入的结果。普通 Bitmap 导出、胶片 JPEG 4:4:4 和 RGBA16 TIFF 共用这项检查。

### 出错后重新开一间暗房

- 异常帧重试先重建 GPU 引擎，丢弃出错引擎的缓存和池状态，再降低工作尺寸重算。修复原来降档后仍沿用同一个引擎的问题。
- 第二次仍异常时停止保存，并替换异常引擎。诊断信息保留原始错误、像素坐标或缺失工作组数，便于后续定位。

releases.name: v1.0.0 — Winlator 适配包
releases.body:
在 Android（[Winlator](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator)）与 ARM Linux（Wine + Box64）上运行 DFLegacy 60 版单机端的适配包。

## 包含

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `d3d8.dll` | d3d8to9 v1.15.1 预编译包装层（x86，124 KB） |
| `LICENSE.md` | d3d8to9 的 BSD-3-Clause 许可 |
| `使用说明.md` | 完整部署说明 |
| `放置说明.txt` | 快速上手 |

## 解决什么问题

客户端是 2008 年的 32 位程序，**只认 Direct3D 8**。Android 上的 DXVK 只支持 D3D9 及以上，直接跑会黑屏或崩溃。

这个 `d3d8.dll` 把 D3D8 调用逐条翻译成 D3D9：

```
DNF.exe → d3d8.dll → D3D9 → DXVK → Vulkan → Adreno / Mali
```

绕开 Wine 自带的 `wined3d → OpenGL` 路径，走 Vulkan 后端。

## 用法

1. 解压，把 `d3d8.dll` 复制到 `DNF.exe` 同级目录
2. Winlator 容器里设 `WINEDLLOVERRIDES=d3d8=n,b`
3. Box86 / Box64 都打开，DXVK 选 2.x
4. 运行 `DNF.exe`

**Windows 本机不要放这个文件** —— 原生 D3D8 路径工作正常，放进去反而改变渲染路径。

## 前提

服务端需要是 x86 构建（NativeAOT `-r win-x86`），否则在纯 32 位环境里加载不了。相关改动见 [DFLegacyAot](https://github.com/Yoshino-Loli/DFLegacyAot)。

## 未验证项

- `ijl15.dll` 的 WIC JPEG 解码在 Wine 下的表现
- Job Object 的退出联动在 Wine 下的可靠性（失败时手动结束服务端即可）

真机帧数需自行测试，骁龙 8 系预期 25~40 fps。

## 不包含

游戏客户端本体与任何受版权保护的资源。`DNF.exe`、`Script.pvf`、`ImagePacks2` 等权利归原权利人所有。
